principles: Koala core consumes language-neutral validation results only
Configuration remains the strongest source of truth and auto discovery is fallback
Behavior compatibility with existing validate.ts and validate.commands is mandatory
drivers: Support non-JS projects without requiring validate.ts
Reduce verifier.ts coupling before adding more language detectors
Keep DONE gate evidence semantics stable

options.name: A: extract protocol and shell executor first
pros: Creates stable surface for later detector stories
Preserves current language discovery behavior while improving result shape
cons: Does not by itself add PHP or Android-specific discovery

options.name: B: add all language detectors directly in verifier.ts
cons: Keeps growing verifier.ts into a fragile if/else hub
Makes DONE gate/debug UX harder to standardize

options.name: C: introduce full plugin architecture now
cons: Too large for current pain point
Higher migration risk before protocol is stable

chosen: A: extract protocol and shell executor first
rationale: Choose A because it establishes the language-neutral contract and command execution semantics before multiplying detectors. It directly addresses the framework limitation without turning verifier.ts into a larger language-specific adapter pile.

preMortem.scenario: Existing JS projects regress because validate.ts handling changes
preMortem.trigger: validate.ts/json extraction path no longer preserves current output semantics
preMortem.consequence: Current Koala self-validation and JS users lose compatibility
preMortem.mitigation: Keep validate.ts priority and JSON wrapping path intact, add regression smoke for validate.ts and no validate.ts fallback

preMortem.scenario: Command executor hides useful failure output
preMortem.trigger: Output truncation or optional command handling discards stderr details
preMortem.consequence: Users cannot tell whether failure is code, missing dependency, or environment
preMortem.mitigation: Record command/code/output per command and summarize failure reason in details

preMortem.scenario: Protocol types drift from evidence consumers
preMortem.trigger: ValidationResult fields do not match story_advance/test-evidence expectations
preMortem.consequence: TEST/DONE gate blocks despite successful validation
preMortem.mitigation: Use existing allPass/status/summary/details fields and add commands as extension; run story validate evidence smoke
